e: Borrowed from Russian коекчуч (kojekčuč), from Itelmen [Term?].
Borrowed from Afrikaans koeksister, from Dutch koek + sissen.
From Hindi कोयल (koyal), from Sanskrit कोकिल (kokila) which is of onomatopoeic origin.
q: It's a beautiful night / a koel starts up / its one weird note.
